successCriteria.description: `PgLeaveRequestRepository.findByQuery` honours `params.employeeIds` by adding an `employee_id = ANY($n)` condition where the array is pushed as a single parameter, and the filter is applied in the SQL query (not fetched-then-filtered in application code).
`ILeaveService` exposes `list(actor, query)` and `getById(actor, requestId)`, both implemented in `LeaveService` and read-only (never open a transaction).

`list` scopes visibility by role: EMPLOYEE → `employeeIds = [actor.id]`; MANAGER → `[actor.id, ...directReportIds]` (one level via `getEmployeesByManagerId`, not transitive); ADMIN → no `employeeIds` filter.

`getById` returns the request when visible, and throws `NotFoundError('Leave request not found')` when the request is null OR the caller may not see it — invisible and nonexistent produce the identical 404 response.
Visibility is status-independent: a MANAGER sees direct reports' requests in every status (DRAFT/SUBMITTED/APPROVED/REJECTED/CANCELLED), applied identically to `list` and `getById`.

The leave routes expose list and single-read endpoints that parse wire query params (status/leaveTypeCode enum-validated, four date bounds via a `toDate` helper, limit/offset as integers), resolve the actor from `request.user`, return 200 with the array/single request, and map `AppError` via `sendError`.

constraints: Read-only phase: no `IUnitOfWork.withTransaction` is opened by `list`/`getById` or the new routes; no audit-log writes (GP-002 applies only to state-changing operations).
The `employeeIds` scope must be applied in the SQL query (`employee_id = ANY($n)`), never by fetching all rows and filtering in application code; no SQL is written in the service.
The actor id is always taken from `request.user` via `resolveActor` — never a client-supplied id; RBAC/visibility is enforced at the API boundary and in the service, not inline in route handlers.
No new module is mounted in `src/app.ts` — `leaveRoutes` is already mounted; only new handlers inside the existing leave routes module are added.
No other repository changes beyond `findByQuery`; `findById`/`update`/`create` and the existing `ORDER BY start_date DESC` + `LIMIT`/`OFFSET` ordering are preserved.
outOfScope: Mounting new routes in `src/app.ts` (leaveRoutes is already mounted) and the Phase 7 smoke-check extension / unit-test additions.
Any change to the write operations (create/submit/approve/reject/cancel), their authorization, or their transaction/audit semantics.
Transitive (multi-level) manager visibility — direct reports only, one level.

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeaveRequest is visible to an actor iff the actor is ADMIN, or the actor is the request's owner (`employeeId === actor.id`), or the actor is a MANAGER who is the direct manager of the owner (owner's `managerId === actor.id`). Visibility is status-independent and identical for list and single-read; an invisible request is indistinguishable from a nonexistent one.

`employeeIds` is an optional array filter; when present it restricts results to requests whose `employee_id` is in the set, applied in the query. The service may override/merge it for role scoping but must never widen an EMPLOYEE/MANAGER scope beyond the role rule.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Authenticated actor required; role scoping: EMPLOYEE → own requests only, MANAGER → own + direct reports, ADMIN → all. Read-only, no transaction.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns an array (possibly empty); no NotFoundError for an empty result.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Authenticated actor required; same visibility rule as list. Read-only, no transaction.
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: NotFoundError('Leave request not found') for a null request OR one the caller may not see — identical 404 for invisible and nonexistent.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: None (data-access layer; scoping is the service's responsibility).
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Returns an array (possibly empty); applies `employee_id = ANY($n)` when `employeeIds` is provided.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Reuse the existing `resolveActor` helper (reads `request.user`, enforces role membership, throws UnauthorizedError) and `sendError` (maps AppError to `{ error, code }`, other throws to 500) — do not re-implement them.
Reuse the existing `toDate` conversion convention from `parseCreateBody` (accepts Date/string/number, throws ValidationError on invalid) for the four date-bound query params.
Resolve direct reports via `IEmployeeService.getEmployeesByManagerId(actor.id)` (one level, empty array when none, no throw) — do not re-implement manager traversal.
`employeeIds` filter must match the `LeaveRequestQueryParams.employeeIds?: string[]` field already declared in shared types; no shared-type change.
`getById` must reuse the existing `NotFoundError('Leave request not found')` message/type so invisible and nonexistent requests produce the identical 404 body.
Preserve the existing `findByQuery` condition-building and `ORDER BY start_date DESC` + `LIMIT`/`OFFSET` ordering; add the `employeeIds` condition alongside the existing filters.

integrationPoints.why: MANAGER role scoping resolves direct reports for the visibility filter.
Query param shape and enum validation for the read surface.
Typed error semantics for invisible/nonexistent (404), invalid query params (400), and missing actor (401).
